title: Impl plan creates or selects a ticket before material planning
query: Plan a material UI change for AGI Toy Shop's checkout flow. No ticket is selected yet.
reference_points: Does not return a chat-only material implementation plan
Creates or requests a selected tickets/TASK-XXXX/ticket.md surface before treating the plan as ready
Writes or proposes Done and QA Strategy with concrete checks and evidence
Names proof weight and delegated proof lanes
Leaves implementation gated until the ticket plan is approved
notes: Guards the ticket-first planning behavior requested in TASK-0207.

title: Impl plan gives UI work a design baseline and how-to-test path
query: Plan a dashboard visual refresh where layout, spacing, and interactions must be proved by screenshots.
reference_points: Adds or references tickets/TASK-XXXX/design.md when design/layout is part of proof
Names key screens or states that QA must capture
Specifies qa-tester for screenshot/log capture and visual-qa for screen judgment
Requires final image evidence in the completion report
Avoids treating route completion or tests alone as enough visual proof
notes: Protects against UI plans with vague 'test manually' proof.

title: Impl plan creates a structured visual companion file
query: Plan a material cross-skill change where the ticket has multiple change units and the operator wants to read diagrams first.
reference_points: Creates and links an existing, validator-passing tickets/TASK-XXXX/diagrams.md companion
Keeps all Mermaid diagrams out of ticket.md without exception
Does not use a visual_companion not-applicable exemption, including for tiny fixes
diagrams.md has frontmatter or metadata with canonical_contract: ticket.md and blocks_approval: false
diagrams.md includes explicit Before and After sections or headings
diagrams.md includes Mermaid classDef color styling for semantic differences
diagrams.md applies colored classes to before/problem and after/added/changed boxes
diagrams.md includes a What Changed or equivalent old-to-new delta when useful
Does not make diagram review part of the reviewer gate unless explicitly requested
notes: Guards the TASK-0308/TASK-0309 convention that visual companions are structured before/after reader aids, not random supplemental diagrams.

title: Impl plan still creates a separate diagram for a tiny fix
query: Use impl-plan for a tiny localized one-file fix where a diagram would normally be considered unnecessary.
reference_points: Creates and links tickets/TASK-XXXX/diagrams.md
Uses a compact Before and After diagram suitable for the small scope
Does not put Mermaid in ticket.md
Does not mark the visual companion not applicable
